title: Investigate 10-second Engram authorization timeout pausing TermAl fan-in delivery
outcome: Identify and fix the cause of the observed authorization timeout, with safe recovery of retained prompts and evidence distinguishing a slow response from an unknown committed outcome.
acceptance: Add a regression for the identified cause proving retained fan-in and mailbox prompts are neither lost nor delivered twice, and that model dispatch still requires valid authorization.

Correlate the 2026-09-23 16:45:24 local incident with TermAl and Engram diagnostics, naming the affected session/build and the phase that exhausted the deadline; record unknowns rather than infer a cause from the screenshot.
Verify bounded, cancellable recovery after the cause is resolved; do not treat repeated manual retries or an increased timeout alone as a root-cause fix.
disposal_reason: Carried in TermAl, not done here: the timeout lives in TermAl's host adapter, and TermAl w-e0f80b315a6d (P3, deferred to 2026-10-03) now holds this incident's provenance and asks for the same regression, correlation and recovery proof (Termal::Fable2 mailbox #53, relayed by Engram::Coder, note 45345db25c4f45b8a8ccc42e1ad83c1e on the parent). None of these three criteria was met; this cancellation is not completion. Decided by Engram::Fable, 2026-09-30.
